description: This file defines a basic ConnectivityMonitor class that manages a stream indicating whether the system is online. It currently treats connectivity as always online, with a placeholder for future real connectivity signals.

classes.name: ConnectivityMonitor
classes.description: A simple class that monitors and provides connectivity status streams, currently hardcoded to always online.

methods.name: ConnectivityMonitor
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the monitor, currently assuming always online and broadcasting true.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Closes the stream controller to clean up resources.
